defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Trace do
  @moduledoc """
  Observable execution trace of the rollout workflow, recorded from any process.
  """
  use Agent

  @doc "Clear the recorded trace and return `:ok`."
  def reset do
    Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn _ -> [] end)
    :ok
  end

  @doc "Return the recorded trace in the order entries were recorded."
  def entries do
    Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn entries ->
      Enum.sort_by(entries, &elem(&1, 0)) |> Enum.map(&elem(&1, 1))
    end)
  end

  @doc "Record one event entry from any process."
  def record(event, label) do
    time = System.monotonic_time()

    Agent.cast(__MODULE__, fn entries ->
      [{time, {event, label}} | entries]
    end)
  end

  def start_link(_opts \\ []) do
    Agent.start_link(fn -> [] end, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def child_spec(opts) do
    %{id: __MODULE__, start: {__MODULE__, :start_link, [opts]}}
  end
end

    # plan_rollout validates targets and returns summary.
    generic :plan_rollout, :query do
      argument :targets, {:array, :map}, allow_nil?: false
      run fn _changeset, %{targets: targets}, _ ->
        cond do
          targets == nil or Enum.empty?(targets) ->
            {:error, invalid_arg(:targets, "targets must be non-empty")}

          Enum.any?(targets, fn t ->

          end) ->
            {:error, invalid_arg(:targets, "all slots must be positive integers")}

            unique = Enum.uniq(names)

            if length(names) != length(unique) do

              {:ok,
               %{

                 node_names: Enum.sort(names),
                 target_count: length(names)
               }}
            end
        end
      end
    end

    |> Orchestra.Fleet.Node.create()

defmodule Ash.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyGenericActionReactorInputs do
  @moduledoc """
  Returns an error if a generic action calls a Reactor module without specifying
  an argument for all expected inputs.
  """
  use Spark.Dsl.Verifier

  def verify(dsl) do
    dsl
    |> Ash.Resource.Info.actions()
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.type == :action))
    |> Enum.reduce_while(:ok, fn action, :ok ->
      case verify_action(action, dsl) do
        :ok -> {:cont, :ok}
        {:error, reason} -> {:halt, {:error, reason}}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp verify_action(%{run: module} = action, dsl) when is_atom(module) do
    if is_reactor?(module) do
      verify_reactor_action(action, module, dsl)
    else
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp verify_action(%{run: {module, _}} = action, dsl) do
    if is_reactor?(module) do
      verify_reactor_action(action, module, dsl)
    else
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp verify_reactor_action(action, module, dsl) do
    reactor = module.reactor()

    required_inputs = MapSet.new(reactor.inputs, & &1.name)
    provided_arguments = MapSet.new(action.arguments, & &1.name)

    required_inputs
    |> MapSet.difference(provided_arguments)
    |> Enum.sort()
    |> case do
      [] ->
        :ok

      missing ->
        missing =
          missing
          |> Enum.map_join(", ", &"`#{inspect(&1)}`")

         Spark.Error.DslError.exception(
           module: Spark.Dsl.Verifier.get_persisted(dsl, :module),
           path: [:actions, :action, action.name],
           message:
             "You need to provide arguments for all the Reactor's inputs.  Missing #{missing}"
         )}
    end
  end

  defp is_reactor?(module) when is_atom(module) do
    module.spark_is() == Reactor
  rescue
    UndefinedFunctionError -> false
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout do
  @moduledoc false
  use Ash.Resource, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets, domain: Orchestra.Fleet

  ets do
    table :rollouts
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read]

    create :create do
      primary? true

    update :update do
      primary? true
    end

    action :plan_rollout do
      argument :targets, {:array, :map}, allow_nil?: false

      run fn input, _context ->
        targets = input.arguments.targets

        cond do
          targets == nil or Enum.empty?(targets) ->
            {:error, invalid_arg(:targets, "targets must be non-empty")}

            unique = Enum.uniq(names)

            if length(names) != length(unique) do
              {:error, invalid_arg(:targets, "duplicate node name")}
            else
              total = Enum.sum(Enum.map(targets, & &1.slots))

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.ApprovalReactor do
  @moduledoc """
  Independently runnable reactor that creates an Approval for a rollout.
  Chooses the approval level (:auto / :board) with a switch step.
  """
  use Reactor, domain: Orchestra.Fleet

  input :rollout_id
  input :total_slots
  input :board_threshold

  step :level do
    switch do
      input :total_slots
      input :board_threshold

      branch :board, fn total, threshold -> total >= threshold end do
        step :level, fn _, _, _ -> {:ok, :board} end
      end

      branch :auto, fn _, _ -> true end do
        step :level, fn _, _, _ -> {:ok, :auto} end
      end
    end
  end

  step :create do
    create Orchestra.Fleet.Approval, :create do
      argument :rollout_id, :rollout_id
      argument :slots, :total_slots
      argument :level, :level
    end
  end

  return :create
end
